sections.text: § 2673. Reports to Congress. The head of each federal agency shall report annually to Congress all claims paid by it under section 2672 of this title , stating the name of each claimant, the amount claimed, the amount awarded, and a brief description of the claim. (June 25, 1948, ch. 646, 62 Stat. 983 .)
